tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon gains are compatible with multiple adaptation laws, while the target horizon is near the stated reversal range. A slow-horizon discriminating observation is the smallest relevant probe to identify the long-timescale contribution before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential reversal model from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations only span H=0.16–0.48 and do not identify the slow component needed to forecast near H=24.9.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled adaptation model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The current rows have s_grad=0 and short horizons, so they do not identify sink coupling or the slow adaptation term.
Fine sampling at short horizons would not resolve the missing long-horizon behavior.
It is not relevant to identifying the forecast law.
